implemented.producer: Hold the original pixel/native lease from immediately after reservation through synchronous or asynchronous factory, original identity, adoption and cleanup. Reentrant scratch/allocator disposal makes inactive immediately but retains actual admission through completed product cleanup. Reject inactive successful outputs after settling so no already-destroyed handle is published. Native successful initializer and generic handoff cleanup failures destroy once without invoking failed-identity recovery after adoption.
implemented.failure: Capture actual factory result and resolved owner before fallible identity/adoption. Invoke an explicit failure-only backing callback at most once while unadopted, never repeat original identity Get, and destroy fresh unowned backing while original admission remains held. Attempt release and final hold separately, preserving first factory/identity/adoption error including null over cleanup/release errors. Same-captured-allocator aliases preserve their original live backing and admission; a misleading overridden buffer getter returning another already-owned alias does not leak the fresh actual native backing.
implemented.registration: Preserve original WeakMap ownership-before-resource-Map insertion. On pre/post ownership or resource insertion failure, remove only attempted lease/record mappings, clear the actual partial resource value/destroy refs and preserve earlier owners. A direct adoption failure leaves its lease usable and its caller-owned product intact for exact retry.
implemented.nativeIdentity: Successful and inactive pixel/readback factory/method/data/buffer receiver and Get sequences remain unchanged. Capture the completed original image data view during identity. Failure-only native typed-array/DataView/ArrayBuffer accessors recover actual detachable backing without repeating user getters; genuine ImageData native data accessor recovers after overriding original data Get throws. After a public backing destructor throws, attempt actual native detachment without repeating public properties before preserving that original cleanup error.
implemented.scope: Fresh detachable native products and aliases already owned by the captured allocator. Foreign-allocator aliases, opaque proxy backing, SharedArrayBuffer, misleading successful identities and fake image products whose original data Get never completed need explicit ownership/producer contracts. Native accessor/descriptor/lease/closure/Map/Set/record/statistics/class/bootstrap byte admission remains separate; selected failure cleanup does not establish production or aggregate admission. Color key-list/kernel/registry, backend/caller/font/provider/Node and native driver/codec RSS remain pending.
